name: Seebensee and the Coburger Hütte
why: Up to a green lake that mirrors the Zugspitze, and on to a hut beside the dark Drachensee under limestone walls.
book: Ehrwalder Almbahn gondola shortens the climb.
dangers: Steep steps to the Coburger Hütte.
Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: start early and be off ridges by 14:00.
